description: This file defines the EmploymentStatus class within the OrangeHRM reporting filter field module. The class extends FilterField and implements ValueXNormalizable, providing functionality to add employment status criteria to database queries, retrieve entity aliases, and convert a value to an array including employment status details.

classes.name: EmploymentStatus
classes.description: Represents an employment status filter field for reports, capable of adding conditions to queries and converting values to a descriptive array.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Adds a condition to the query builder if the operator is EQUAL and the value X is not null, filtering employees by employment status.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns the array of entity aliases used in the query, in this case, ['employee'].

methods.name: toArrayXValue
methods.description: Fetches the employment status entity by ID and returns an array with its id and label for display purposes.
